scope: 25 independently authored mathematical selection workflows; no Evoto algorithm or model equivalence claimed

features.label: CIE Lab sampled distance
features.mechanism: Convert source sRGB through D65 XYZ into CIE Lab; select by CIE76 distance to the sample. Tolerance scales to 150 Lab units.

features.label: Covariance colour distance
features.mechanism: Estimate a regularized RGB covariance in the sample patch and select by Mahalanobis distance. Flat patches remain finite; this measures colour statistics, not subjects.

features.label: Geodesic colour propagation
features.mechanism: Propagate from the sample by minimum accumulated RGB edge cost with deterministic integer Dijkstra traversal. Radius sets cost budget and tolerance sets colour crossing cost.

features.label: Local Otsu threshold
features.mechanism: Choose a separate 16-bin between-class variance threshold in each local luminance patch. Flat patches are excluded. Produces hard coverage.

features.label: Sauvola adaptive threshold
features.mechanism: Compare source luminance with a local mean and standard-deviation threshold. Corner sets the Sauvola coefficient; pure black stays unselected.

features.label: Gabor frequency response
features.mechanism: Measure DC-removed Gaussian-windowed cosine response. Angle sets frequency direction; corner maps wavelength from 2 to 16 cells. Select the response with the range.

features.label: Directional bright ridges
features.mechanism: Project the source Hessian onto an angle and select negative curvature. This isolates bright ridges rather than first-derivative edges.

features.label: Local tonal skewness
features.mechanism: Measure the third standardized local luminance moment. Symmetry and flat patches map to 0.5; positive outlier tails map above it.

features.label: Local tonal kurtosis
features.mechanism: Measure local excess fourth standardized luminance moment, centered at 0.5 and scaled by 12. Flat patches map to 0.5.

features.label: Colour-line residual
features.mechanism: Estimate the dominant RGB covariance direction in a sample patch using power iteration. Select perpendicular distance to that colour line; this can isolate colours outside a shading ramp.

features.label: Grayscale morphological opening
features.mechanism: Erode then dilate coverage with the same square structuring element. Removes thin bright protrusions and retains grayscale values. Outside-frame coverage is transparent.

features.label: Grayscale morphological closing
features.mechanism: Dilate then erode coverage with the same square structuring element. Bridges small dark gaps. Transparent boundaries can trim coverage at the frame edge.

features.label: Opening by reconstruction
features.mechanism: Erode coverage to form a marker, then propagate its grayscale maxima under the original coverage ceiling. Connected surviving regions recover their contours.

features.label: Grayscale area opening
features.mechanism: Build descending upper-level components with a union-find max-tree. Suppress bright structures whose area is below the minimum at each coverage level.

features.label: Keep border-connected regions
features.mechanism: Retain complete four-connected regions that touch any frame edge at the 50% coverage threshold. Preserves retained grayscale coverage.

features.label: Seed geodesic distance bands
features.mechanism: Measure shortest four-neighbor path distance inside the 50% selection from the sample. Range selects distance divided by radius; disconnected islands remain excluded.

features.label: Keep regions enclosing holes
features.mechanism: Flood each component complement from a padded exterior to detect enclosed holes. Retain the surrounding component, preserving its coverage; solid regions are excluded.

features.label: Regional coverage maxima
features.mechanism: Traverse equal-coverage plateaus and retain only nonzero plateaus with no greater four-neighbor coverage. Flat-topped maxima stay connected.

features.label: Archimedean spiral ribbon
features.mechanism: Construct a ribbon around a growing Archimedean spiral within elliptical bounds. Radius sets turn count, angle rotates it, and tolerance sets radial half-width.

features.label: Barycentric triangle gradient
features.mechanism: Use the first three vertices to construct a triangle with coverage fading from vertex one toward the opposite edge. Corner controls the gradient exponent; collinear vertices are rejected.

features.label: Affine selection shear
features.mechanism: Inverse-map coverage through a horizontal shear about the bounds center. Angle maps through sine to shear strength from -1.5 to 1.5. Transparent sampling clips outside the frame.

features.label: Radial selection twirl
features.mechanism: Rotate source sample coordinates with a quadratic radial falloff inside elliptical bounds. Angle sets centre rotation; the ellipse boundary stays fixed.

features.label: Spherical selection remap
features.mechanism: Inverse-map coverage with a normalized arctangent radial projection inside elliptical bounds. Corner blends projection strength; the bounds boundary stays fixed.

features.label: Image-gradient displacement
features.mechanism: Move coverage sample coordinates along source luminance gradients. Tolerance sets displacement strength; source pixels remain read-only and out-of-frame coverage is transparent.

features.label: Signed-distance edge smoothing
features.mechanism: Compute graph distance on both sides of the 50% selection interface and remap it with a logistic profile. Radius sets softness; fully selected or empty frames retain exact coverage.

verification.limits: This ledger records synthetic numerical and UI request validation. Desktop save/undo and user-photo qualification are tracked by the parent task reports.

invariants: Each operation computes a complete temporary output and checks cancellation before replacing coverage.
Source RGB and luminance are read-only.
Coverage grids are limited to 512 cells per edge and source analysis radius to eight cells.
Nonfinite coordinates, invalid intervals, mismatched source grids and degenerate triangles are rejected.
Transparent out-of-frame bilinear sampling is explicit; morphology uses transparent frame boundaries.
Empty and single-cell inputs are covered; geodesic bands require a selected seed.
limitations: These are mathematical selection tools, not trained or semantic segmentation.
No claim of Evoto feature, algorithm, model or numerical output equivalence.
Source measurements use the existing unadjusted preview sampled on the selection grid.
A selection workflow test establishes its stated numerical behavior, not photographic perfection.
